text: Admission target: Non-Chinese citizens holding valid ordinary foreign passports and having studied the language in China for no more than one year.Age requirement: 18-40 years old (Applicants for scholarship programs must meet the age requirements of each program).Physical condition: Good health, meeting the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa to China.Moral cultivation: Be friendly to China, have good conduct, abide by laws and regulations, respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people, and have no record of illegal or disciplinary violations.Financial situation: Be able to guarantee the payment of corresponding tuition fees, accommodation fees and daily living expenses.
